claim_text: Conductivity decouples from segmental relaxation more strongly in the measured rigid-backbone samples than in flexible controls
quantifier: five named materials over a declared fit window
observable: BDS conductivity sigma; segmental relaxation time tau_s
target_mechanism: failure of the composite constant-carrier constant-correlation single-timescale model
empirical_scope: comb-like amorphous polymers; LiClO4 0.3-1.0 wt%; O:Li 220:1-540:1; declared temperature or tau_s window
measurement_inference_chain: fit log(sigma*T)=alpha+beta*log(tau_s); compare constrained beta=-1 with free beta; epsilon=1+beta; predict held-out sigma
main_assumptions_or_nuisance: correlated BDS fit errors; fit-window selection; carrier population; collective correlation; salt content; Tg; chemistry
author_stated_limitations: reported figure and SI epsilon values support a departure for named rigid samples but raw curves covariance and exact near-Tg fit window are unavailable
verdict: supported from reported fits; independent predictive refit pending
promotion_ceiling: descriptive failure of the composite null only

claim_text: Inferred ion diffusivity decouples from segmental relaxation
quantifier: five studied materials under the selected model
measurement_inference_chain: dielectric spectrum -> Debye-like EP omega_max and tan(delta)_max -> Trukhan inversion -> normalized D
main_assumptions_or_nuisance: monovalent ions with equal mobility; Debye-like EP; Delta-epsilon_EP much greater than epsilon_R; blocking boundary; electrode/model validity; normalization
author_stated_limitations: SI derives approximate Trukhan-MacDonald equivalence under the stated conditions; main text says the treatment remains qualitative because electrode-material effects are omitted

claim_text: Changes in mobility rather than mobile-ion fraction dominate the transport enhancement
measurement_inference_chain: EP inversion -> normalized D and p -> attribution of sigma change
main_assumptions_or_nuisance: D/p tradeoff; population sensitivity; equal diffusivity; normalization
author_stated_limitations: paper notes disagreement with tracer Raman PFG-NMR and simulation trends and leaves it unresolved
promotion_ceiling: cannot identify dominance without independent D and carrier measurements

claim_text: Decoupling magnitude correlates more strongly with kinetic fragility than with Tg
measurement_inference_chain: VFT fit to tau_s -> fragility m; tau_s and sigma/D -> epsilon; cross-material regression
main_assumptions_or_nuisance: shared tau_s and VFT fits; small n; chemistry and salt covariation; rounded public inputs
author_stated_limitations: the rounded SI table preserves the qualitative ordering but does not reproduce the exact reported R-squared values; unrounded regression inputs are unavailable

claim_text: Rigid chains frustrate packing and create loose local structure that facilitates ion transport
quantifier: possibility narrative rather than universal law
measurement_inference_chain: rigidity/fragility association -> inferred loose packing -> facilitated transport
main_assumptions_or_nuisance: unmeasured packing/free volume; association; local mobility; morphology
author_stated_limitations: framed as a possible scenario rather than an exclusive necessary mechanism

claim_text: Fragility or rigidity is the unique cause of decoupling
main_assumptions_or_nuisance: would require matched interventions and mediator closure
promotion_ceiling: must not be attributed or falsified
